title: 717. To Lower Case

examples.explanation: Uppercase H becomes lowercase; the rest stay as they are.
Every uppercase letter shifts to its lowercase form.
Only the letter B changes; digits and symbols are untouched.

hints: Only characters in 'A' to 'Z' need changing; add 32 to their code or use a lookup.
Leave lowercase letters, digits and symbols exactly as they appear.
A single left-to-right pass building a new string is enough.
